title: GRADIUS 1985 | Stage 1 Volcano
originalBrief: Recreate the simplest original 1985 Gradius Stage 1 (Volcano) as a repeatable test of our existing Level Builder. First a human-guided game-asset agent audits and finishes existing artwork, SpriteShape profiles, prefabs, spawners, volcano projectile mechanics and the right Big Core boss in Unity. Only AFTER assets are complete and accepted, the automatic Level Builder creates Layer0 v6 JSON for a NEW scene. Then Reverse Wave Authoring creates/validates enemy waves, followed by Play QA. Create a separate visible level dossier on our automatic level site. Do not redo existing art or overwrite GRAD1.

gaps.description: Validate existing sprites, profile and animations before any level recipe.
Verify existing volcano crater system can eject timed destructible rocks.
Build or verify true Big Core shield/core/laser behavior; no generic boss proxy.
Verify two launcher types and prefab-relative launch origin.
Unity has an unsaved SCENE_Cutscene_Workshop modal. Do not dismiss or overwrite other scene.

decisions.reference: User explicitly required designer agent finish all graphics/prefabs/bosses before automated Level Builder JSON.
decisions.description: Preflight asset readiness gates Level Builder; split ownership between game-asset and JSON generation agents.

lastCompletedAction: Verified website state, local Unity Editor, missing new scene, 15 draft waves and six published QA runs; published accurate status ledger in website repo commit 1c507c8.
nextAction: Preserve active Unity Cutscene Workshop; validate asset gameplay and implement missing Big Core/volcano behavior; only then generate new LevelBuilder V6 scene and waves, playtest and publish proof.
